name: Kailua
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kailua, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kailua, Hawaii for 2026: 4 family events, 4 free, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Kailua keeps Christmas with local parades, Santa visits and community events.
celebrates: Kailua's Christmas runs through its town calendar and its community groups. Kailua Town lists a December 2 Community Christmas Tree Lighting at Adventist Health Castle with free trolley service from Kailua Town Center, and complimentary Santa photos at Out to See in Lau Hala Shops on December 5. The same evening, Kailua Assembly of God holds Christmas Kanikapila and Lights with a petting zoo, Christmas snow and live music. Waimanalo, just down the coast, has no page of its own, so its library's Santa story time is listed here.
lastyear: Kailua Town's 2025 holiday post told families to ride the free holiday trolley to Adventist Health Castle's annual Christmas Tree Lighting for a night of lights and music. The trolley service returns in 2026, again provided by Alexander and Baldwin between the hospital and Kailua Town Center, with a stop at the Kailua Town Center parking garage behind Longs CVS.
facts: The Kailua Town events calendar tags the tree lighting as a free event with free shuttles, and the trolley starts at 5 pm. Kailua Assembly of God's Christmas Kanikapila and Lights lists about 18 vendors and four sets of live performers, and parking at the church is free, with an overflow lot and shuttle at Kalaheo High School until 10 pm.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Kailua. The closest tradition is the free holiday trolley to the December 2 tree lighting. Pearlridge Center in Aiea runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Mauka Center Court from November 21, 2026, to January 10, 2027, at $6 per child for children under 48 inches tall. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs a Holiday Express Train Ride, a 90-minute nonstop evening ride decorated with hundreds of lights where riders can wear holiday pajamas, according to our museum page on the society.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, with a Holiday Express Train Ride on restored track.
traditions: Adventist Health Castle's annual lighting, with a free trolley from Kailua Town Center.
A free church evening with lights, live music, a petting zoo and Christmas snow.
Complimentary photos with Santa at Lau Hala Shops.
A free half-hour of holiday stories at Waimanalo Public Library.
kidfact: A free trolley takes families to Kailua's tree lighting, so nobody has to hunt for parking.
faq: With the Adventist Health Castle tree lighting and free trolley, free Santa photos at Out to See and a church Christmas Kanikapila and Lights evening.
When is the Kailua tree lighting in 2026?
Wednesday, December 2, 2026, listed from 5 to 9 pm, with free trolley service starting at 5 pm.
Is there a free Santa event in Kailua?
Yes, Photos with Santa at Out to See on Saturday, December 5, from 4 to 6 pm.
Where do we park for the tree lighting?
At the Kailua Town Center parking garage behind Longs CVS, then ride the free trolley.
Is there a Christmas train ride in Kailua?
We did not find one. Pearlridge Center in Aiea has a holiday train.

folded.why: Waimanalo Public Library story time is built here (cand 65333). The Waimanalo Christmas Parade (Dec 12) is only on Facebook, so it is held.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kailua for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, all of them free. The magic runs from December 2 (Adventist Health Castle Christmas Tree Lighting with Free Trolley) through December 15 (Santa Claus Story Time at Waimanalo Public Library), with Photos with Santa at Out to See and Christmas Kanikapila and Lights (both December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kailua

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Kailua
  • 4 free events: the tree lighting, photos with Santa at Out to See, Christmas Kanikapila and Lights and the Waimanalo library story time
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Out to See (December 5) and Santa Claus Story Time in Waimanalo (December 15)
  • Tree lightings: Adventist Health Castle's Community Christmas Tree Lighting with free trolley service (December 2)
  • Trains: none in town; a free holiday trolley carries families to the December 2 tree lighting
  • Season: December 2 to December 15

Planning a bigger day out? Kailua families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Honolulu, which covers Honolulu City Lights, Kapolei City Lights, the Grinch musical at Diamond Head Theatre, 'Twas the Light Before Christmas on Ice and The Nutcracker.
